hook.name: LiquinkGraduationHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a single Liquink pool that enforces a fixed 2% fee on exact-input swaps, routing buy-side fees (WETH) to a buyback vault and sell-side fees (tokens) to on-chain burns via the curve contract. Also maintains a 300-second TWAP tick history and restricts pool initialization to post-graduation only.
